title: Viettel My Agent
overview: AI-powered conversational platform with streaming responses, document knowledge management, and workflow automation deployed on Kubernetes.
challenge: Build a ChatGPT-inspired interface supporting real-time streaming updates, artifact rendering (files, video, HTML), and document search while maintaining production stability across distributed infrastructure.
contributions: Engineered web interface (React) with async chunk processors consuming SSE streams for streaming responses and interactive document search.
Designed API Gateway service (NestJS) handling data processing and chat streaming via Server-Sent Events with Redis caching strategy.
Built visual node-based workflow configuration tool (Vue.js) enabling non-technical staff to configure chatbot logic without code changes.
Implemented document knowledge management system: ingestion pipeline, indexing, and retrieval optimization for LLM context windows.
Enhanced CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, improving deployment consistency and reducing release friction.
Set up observability stack: Prometheus for metrics collection, Grafana dashboards for system health monitoring and debugging.
